title: What the Worker reads from its environment

entities.title: GitHub OAuth App client ID
entities.summary: Identifies the OAuth App to GitHub; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: Set as a Worker secret (README.md, "Setting it up once (the owner)"), though it is not secret: it is in the address the reader is sent to at GitHub.

entities.title: GitHub OAuth App client secret
entities.summary: Proves the Worker is the OAuth App when it exchanges a code; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: A Worker secret, set with wrangler secret put. Sent only to GitHub's token endpoint.

entities.title: Session secret
entities.summary: The secret the cookies' AES-GCM key is derived from; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: Any long random string. Every pending sign-in and every session is sealed with a key derived from it, so changing it signs everyone out.

entities.title: Public origin
entities.summary: The app's address: the start of the OAuth callback address, and the Origin sign-out must come from.
entities.details: Set in wrangler.jsonc under vars. The OAuth App's registered callback must be this origin followed by /auth/github/callback.

entities.title: Who may use /admin
entities.summary: A user signed in to icelander.net who holds the login service's role explorer:admin; the GitHub OAuth App's login no longer counts.
entities.type: a role of icelander.net's login service
entities.takesEffect: at once: the Worker asks the login service on every request
entities.details: The owners (OWNER_EMAILS on the accounts Worker) hold every role there is; anyone else is granted it on the login service's admin page. The role has to be added to the login service's ROLES (accounts/src/config.js in icelander.net) before anyone holds it; until then, and without ACCOUNTS and ACCOUNTS_JWKS, nobody gets into /admin. It does not depend on REQUIRE_SIGN_IN. This Worker has no setting for it, and the admin page can't change it.

entities.title: The crawler's database, bucket and queue
entities.summary: DB, SPACE and SCANS, the same D1 database, R2 bucket and queue the crawler uses.
entities.details: Without them /api/space and the admin API answer 503 and the rest of the Worker works as before. The owner creates them once (crawler/README.md, "Setting it up once").

entities.title: REQUIRE_SIGN_IN
entities.summary: "true" makes the page, /api/space*, /auth/github/start and /api/github/* need a sign-in to icelander.net; "false" or unset leaves them open.

entities.title: ACCOUNTS and ACCOUNTS_JWKS
entities.summary: The service binding to icelander.net's login service (same Cloudflare account) and its public keys; without them nobody is signed in, and nobody gets into /admin.
